snapshot.text: Public system with large gaps between Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire and rural areas. Recent cholera outbreaks and a National Health Council have pushed governance reforms and improvements at the main referral hospital.

priorities.title: Using cholera response to build the system
priorities.text: Lessons from the cholera response are to strengthen the wider health system.

priorities.title: Better care at Adolphe-Sicé hospital
priorities.text: Measures to improve the quality of care at the Adolphe-Sicé general hospital.
